posts.title: MA STUDIO Unveils Tirana Riverfront Pavilion at Design Week
posts.excerpt: The studio presented a timber-and-stone pavilion along the Lana River, framing a new public threshold between the boulevard and the water. The installation is open to visitors through the end of the month as part of Tirana Design Week.

posts.title: Skanderbeg Mixed-Use Tower Wins WAF Future Project Award
posts.excerpt: Our 24-storey mixed-use proposal for central Tirana was recognised at the World Architecture Festival for its stacked public terraces and low-carbon structural strategy.

posts.title: “From the City to Mankind” — Ervin Taçi at the Venice Biennale
posts.excerpt: A lecture on designing across scales — from urban frameworks down to the human threshold — delivered as part of the Albanian Pavilion’s public programme at the Biennale Architettura.

posts.title: Studio Expands with New Landscape & Energy Practice
posts.excerpt: Two new in-house teams bring landscape architecture and building-energy engineering under one roof, deepening the studio’s remit across the full arc from the city to mankind.

posts.title: Open Studio: “Modelling Architecture” Exhibition Opens in Tirana
posts.excerpt: Drawings, models and process work from a decade of practice go on show at the studio. The exhibition runs all month, with guided walkthroughs each weekend.

posts.title: Adriatic Coastal Masterplan Shortlisted for the Mies Award
posts.excerpt: Our coastal masterplan framework was named to the shortlist for the EU Mies van der Rohe Award, recognised for balancing public access, ecology and resilient growth along the Adriatic.
